title: Number of influential coordinates
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $\tau>0$. Then $|\{i:I_i(f)\ge\tau\}|\le I(f)/\tau$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For $\tau > 0$ the number of $\tau$-influential coordinates satisfies
$\abs{J_\tau(f)} \le I[f]/\tau$.
